solves.reasoning: (A) reflection - aesthetic processing AND reflection on meaning. (B) importance - relative importance of subject matter. (C) background - style (i.e., background).
(A) resembles - subject matter that resembles everyday life. (B) facilitate - to facilitate the construction. (C) mental - mental models.
(A) novel - novel stylistic devices (new, not traditional). (B) disquieting - inharmonious manner creates disquieting atmosphere. (C) conventional - departure from conventional forms.
pragmatic은 실용적이란 뜻. 원문 aesthetic(미학적)이어야 함. depth of aesthetic processing이 맞는 표현.
adherence는 고수/순응. 원문 departure(벗어남)이어야 함. 관습적 형식으로부터의 벗어남.
obstruct는 방해하다. 원문 facilitate(촉진하다)이어야 함. 배경 양식은 정신 모델 구성을 촉진.
This active ___ provides a basis - involvement(참여). active와 결합하는 명사.
carry the viewer along to the ___ of the piece - conclusion(끝). 작품의 끝까지 이끈다.
creating a ___ atmosphere - inharmonious manner에 이어지므로 disquieting(불안한). conventional/balanced/fundamental은 문맥에 안 맞음.
facilitate = promote (촉진하다). complicate/prevent/delay는 반의어.
departure = deviation (벗어남, 이탈). conformity(순응)는 반의어.
fundamental = essential (근본적인, 필수적인). trivial/optional/marginal은 반의어.
novel(새로운) 반의어 = conventional(관습적인). innovative/original/creative는 동의어.
disquieting(불안한) 반의어 = reassuring(안심시키는). unsettling/disturbing/alarming은 동의어.
(A) meaning of the work = 작품(명사). (B) devices work in a manner = 작동하다(동사).
concerned with beauty = aesthetic(미학적인). pragmatic(실용적)/conventional(관습적)/fundamental(근본적)은 다른 뜻.
active + 명사 자리. involve → involvement.
highly + 형용사 자리. represent → representational.
provides a basis for ___ and reflection - depth of aesthetic processing가 원문. 다른 선지들도 본문에 있지만 다른 문맥.
aesthetic attitude is needed to ___ - appreciate the whole episode가 원문. 감상하다.
